title: Page 5
content_zh:
一旁的梁昭颖同样悲伤，却还是强忍着伤痛安慰母亲。“娘，还有女儿陪伴着您，女儿绝对不会一一”
“为什么病死的人不是你？”梁秦氏突然激动地紧抓住她双肩，睁着一双爬满血丝的眼瞪着她。“旭儿从小就体弱多病，都是你害的，他会这么早就离开我们，你脱不了关系！”
“娘，不是我……”她被母亲这突然失控的举动惊吓不已，慌乱地摇头否认。
她也不希望哥哥一生下来身体就虚弱，她真的没有害哥哥的想法，哥哥病死了她也很痛苦难过呀！
“是你，就是你害死旭儿的！”梁秦氏情绪崩溃地哭喊咆哮，不顾一切地朝女儿怒骂出声。“把旭儿还给我，把旭儿还给我！”
“娘，女儿会好好照顾您的，请您……”她的肩膀被掐得好痛，但她并没挣开母亲，只是拚了命地想要安慰。
“你能做什么？你只是个没用的女儿，把儿子还给我！”
“啊一一”
梁秦氏发狂似地突然将梁昭颖给往外一推，害她狠狠地摔倒在地，痛得终于哭出声来，一时无法从地上爬起来。
她不只身体痛，她的心也很痛，母亲这么对她，就像是亲自拿把刀在她的心口划上一刀一样，让她几乎无法承受。
为什么要这样对她？就只因为她是女儿，不是儿子，是吗？如果她和哥哥一样，也是儿子，母亲是不是就不会如此忽略她，也不会将所有错都推到她身上，要她承担这些莫须有的罪过？她好怨，怨自己的女儿身，怨她在母亲的眼里，只是个没用的女儿……
梁秦氏一看到女儿狼狈地跌倒在地，那一瞬间就开始后悔了，她看着自己微微颤抖的双手，才意识到自己刚才发了失心疯，竟狠心地将女儿给推倒在地，还恶毒地咒骂女儿。
她……她真的无法控制自己，内心的悲痛需要发泄的出口，而女儿就成了她最好的目标，她理智上知道自己不该怪女儿，但她悲痛的心却办不到。
但做都已经做了，她也不知道该如何收拾残局才好，只能看着女儿趴倒在地，难过地痛哭出声，母女之间更形疏远了。
不知道过了多久，梁昭颖终于停住泪水，从地上爬起，用一种从来没在她脸上出现过的无比坚定眼神，瞧着自己的母亲，勇敢地将话给说出口一一“娘，我无法将哥哥还给您，但是我会代替哥哥继续活在这世上，我会证明我并不是一无是处的女儿。”
“什么？你……”梁秦氏讶异地一愣，没想到女儿会有如此大的转变。
“大哥能做的事情，我也可以做，而且绝对不会比大哥差，就算只剩下我一个女儿，梁家也不会倒，就请您好好的看着吧！”她不想再继续委屈下去了，她一定要有所改变，还要活出自己的一片天地。
过去那一个文静顺从的梁昭颖已经死了，现在的这一个梁昭颖，会彻底重生，不让母亲再轻视忽略她。
她相信自己可以做到的，绝对可以，谁都不能小看她！
从回忆的恶梦中惊醒，躺在床上的梁昭颖流了满身冷汗，气息喘急，还无法从恶梦中强烈的怨怒情绪中平稳下来。

她缓缓坐起身，房里寒冷的空气终于让她逐渐冷静下来，情绪不再那样激动，她再深吸了几口气，才走下床，来到盆架边将一身湿汗给擦掉。
冰凉的水让她完全清醒了，也不再去想梦中的事情，反正都已经发生了，也没法改变，还去想那些要做什么呢？现在的她，只想努力的继续往前走，将过去给抛得远远的，再也不想提起。
梳洗完毕，她来到衣架前，就见到架上放着几天前去墓前探望哥哥时，戚无烟亲手帮她披上的披风，她珍惜地抚着天蓝色布料上淡淡的银色竹叶花纹，原本凝重的脸色缓和了，还多了一丝浅浅笑意。
戚无烟一定不知道，她第一次跟着哥哥到戚家，从第一眼见到他的那一刻起，就像京里其它姑娘一样，被他那淡然若谪仙的气质所吸引，偷偷地喜欢上他了，所以一有机会，她就会跟着哥哥一起到戚家去，靠着哥哥的关系，和他见上一面。
只可惜那时候的他根本就没把她给放在眼里，直到哥哥死后，他才终于正视她的存在，还对她非常的照顾。
有时候，她真不知该感谢哥哥，还是怨哥哥多事，因为如果没有哥哥的托付，她可能永远都入不了他的眼，但这样却让他从一开始就把她当妹妹在照顾，而不是把她当成女人看待。
她非常矛盾，既想拥有他的关心，却又希望两人的关系能够有所转变，希望他能够……喜欢上她。
有可能吗？她想，应该很难吧，所以她只能让两人的关系维持现状，不敢有任何突破改变，就怕一改变，会连他唯一的关心都会失去，再也无法像现在一样靠近他，没有任何隔阂。
“该把披风还给他了……”她脸上的笑容不减，心想能顺便借着这个理由和他见见面，他们俩也有好几天没见面了。
穿好衣裳，将披风细心地折迭好，抱在怀里，梁昭颖推开房门，才发现外头已经下起雪来，难怪一早起来就觉得好冷。
她连早膳都不吃，直接出门去，没想到在经过前厅门前时，被梁秦氏给硬生生叫住，绊下了她的脚步。
“颖儿。”
梁昭颖顿了一下，虽然很想马上离开，却还是转身进到前厅，脸上漾起轻松的笑。“娘，有事吗？”
“你早膳不吃就想出门了？到底有什么事情非得这么赶才行？”梁秦氏板着脸，语气也略嫌冷淡。
“没什么，我只是没胃口用早膳罢了。”梁昭颖耸耸肩，早已习惯母亲淡漠的口气。
梁秦氏瞧着自己的女儿，已经不知道该拿她怎么办才好了，自从三年前那一晚事情发生之后，女儿的言行举止就越来越让人担心，而她却无力挽回任何事。
她真的不知道事情会变成现在这样，女儿代替早逝的儿子管理起粮行生意，甚至还把自己打扮成男人的样子，她以为当年女儿说要代替哥哥活下来只是一时的气话，没想到……却是真的。
“颖儿，你到底还要和我闹脾气多久？我已经认命，也接受事实，旭儿不会再回来了，你不是旭儿，根本就不可能代替他活下去的，不是吗？”她只希望剩下的唯一一个女儿能恢复正常，别再不男不女下去。
她早就后悔三年前一时失心疯，将女儿推倒在儿子灵堂前那件事，但嫌隙已生，她也拉不下脸道歉，母女俩的关系是越来越糟糕。
“为什么不能？”都过了这么多年，她还是得不到母亲的认同，这让她非常的不平及气恼。“哥能做的事情，我都做到了，不是吗？”

她早已不是什么都不会的柔弱姑娘，她可以独自管理粮行，可以和一群男人打交道、做生意，她没有什么事情做不来的，只除了做回原来的那一个梁昭颖。
“但你毕竟还是个女人，不是男人，如果旭儿还在，或许他早已娶妻生子，为梁家传宗接代了，但你行吗？”她本想好好和女儿说话，结果被女儿一激，说的话又忍不住尖酸刻薄起来。
梁昭颖的表情瞬间僵了下来，一时之间找不到话可以反击，但不消多久，她转而大笑出声，像是听到了什么非常可笑的话一样。
content_en:
Liang Zhaoying on the side was equally sad, but she still endured the pain and comforted her mother. "Mom, you still have your daughter with you, and your daughter will never do it one by one."
"Why weren't you the one who died of illness?" Liang Qin suddenly grabbed her shoulders in excitement and stared at her with bloodshot eyes. "Xu'er has been weak and sick since he was a child, and it's all your fault. He would leave us so early, and you can't get rid of it!"
"Mom, it's not me..." She was frightened by her mother's sudden out-of-control behavior, and shook her head in denial in panic.
She also didn't want her brother to be weak from birth. She really had no intention of harming her brother. She was also very painful and sad when his brother died of illness!
"It's you, you're the one who killed Xu'er!" Liang Qin cried and roared with an emotional breakdown, scolding her daughter desperately. "Give Xu'er back to me, give Xu'er back to me!"
"Mom, my daughter will take good care of you, please..." Her shoulder was pinched so much that it hurt, but she did not break away from her mother, she just desperately wanted to be comforted.
"What can you do? You are just a useless daughter, give me your son back!"
"Ah Yiyi"
Liang Qin suddenly pushed Liang Zhaoying out like crazy, causing her to fall to the ground hard. She finally cried out in pain and was unable to get up from the ground for a while.
Not only was her body hurting, but her heart was also hurting. Her mother treating her like this was like taking a knife and cutting her heart. It was almost unbearable for her.
Why do you do this to her? Just because she is a daughter, not a son, right? If she was a son like her brother, wouldn't her mother ignore her so much, and put all the blame on her, asking her to bear these unwarranted sins? She is very resentful, she blames herself for being a daughter, she blames her for being just a useless daughter in her mother's eyes...
As soon as Liang Qin saw her daughter falling to the ground in embarrassment, she began to regret it at that moment. She looked at her slightly trembling hands and realized that she had just gone crazy and cruelly pushed her daughter to the ground and cursed her viciously.
She...she really couldn't control herself. Her inner grief needed an outlet, and her daughter became her best target. She knew intellectually that she shouldn't blame her daughter, but her grieving heart couldn't do it.
But everything had been done, and she didn't know how to clean up the mess. She could only watch her daughter lying on the ground, crying sadly, and the mother and daughter became even more estranged.
I don't know how long it took, but Liang Zhaoying finally stopped crying, got up from the ground, looked at her mother with a firm look that had never appeared on her face before, and bravely said the words - "Mom, I can't return my brother to you, but I will continue to live in this world in my brother's place, and I will prove that I am not a worthless daughter."
"What? You..." Liang Qin was stunned, not expecting her daughter to have such a big change.
"I can do what the eldest brother can do, and I will definitely not be worse than the eldest brother. Even if I am the only daughter left, the Liang family will not fall. Please watch carefully!" She didn't want to continue to be wronged. She must make changes and live her own world.
The quiet and obedient Liang Zhaoying in the past is dead. The current Liang Zhaoying will be completely reborn and will not let her mother despise and ignore her again.
She believes that she can do it, she can absolutely do it, and no one can underestimate her!
Waking up from the nightmare of memories, Liang Zhaoying was lying on the bed covered in cold sweat, breathing heavily, and was still unable to calm down from the strong resentment and anger in the nightmare.
She slowly sat up. The cold air in the room finally calmed her down, and she was no longer so excited. She took a few more deep breaths before walking out of bed and going to the basin shelf to wipe off the wet sweat.
The cold water made her completely awake, and she no longer thought about what happened in her dream. Anyway, it had already happened.There's nothing you can do to change it, so why bother thinking about what to do? Now, she just wants to work hard to move forward, put the past far away, and never want to mention it again.
After washing up, she came to the clothes rack and saw on the rack the cloak that Qi Wuyan put on for her when she went to visit her brother at the grave a few days ago. She cherished the faint silver bamboo leaf pattern on the sky blue cloth, and her original solemn expression softened, and there was a hint of a smile.
Qi Wuyan must not know that she followed her brother to Qi's house for the first time. From the moment she first saw him, like other girls in Beijing, she was attracted by his indifferent and immortal temperament and secretly fell in love with him. Therefore, whenever she had a chance, she would follow her brother to Qi's house and rely on his relationship to meet him.
It's a pity that he didn't pay attention to her at all at that time. It wasn't until his brother died that he finally faced her existence and took great care of her.
Sometimes, she really didn't know whether to thank her brother or blame him for being troublesome, because without his trust, she might never be able to fall in his eyes, but this made him take care of her as a sister from the beginning, instead of treating her as a woman.
She is very conflicted. She wants to have his care, but she also hopes that their relationship can change, and that he can... like her.
Is it possible? She thought it must be difficult, so she could only keep the relationship between the two as it was, not daring to make any breakthroughs or changes, for fear that if she changed, she would lose even his only concern, and she would never be able to get close to him like now without any barriers.
"It's time to return the cloak to him..." The smile on her face continued, thinking that she could use this excuse to meet him. They hadn't seen each other for several days.
After putting on her clothes, folding her cloak carefully and holding it in her arms, Liang Zhaoying opened the door and found that it was already snowing outside. No wonder she felt so cold when she woke up early in the morning.
She didn't even eat breakfast and went straight out. Unexpectedly, when she passed by the front hall, she was stopped by Liang Qin, who stopped her in her tracks.
"Yinger."
Liang Zhaoying paused for a moment. Although she wanted to leave immediately, she turned around and entered the front hall with a relaxed smile on her face. "Mom, is something wrong?"
"You want to go out without eating breakfast? Why do you have to rush for something?" Liang Qin's face was serious and her tone was a little cold.
"It's nothing, I just don't have the appetite for breakfast." Liang Zhaoying shrugged, already used to her mother's indifferent tone.
Liang Qin looked at her daughter and no longer knew what to do with her. Ever since what happened that night three years ago, her daughter's behavior and words had become more and more worrying, but she was powerless to undo anything.
She really didn't know that things would turn out like this. Her daughter took over the management of the grain store business in place of her son who died young, and even dressed up as a man. She thought that her daughter's words that she wanted to survive in her brother's place were just temporary words of anger, but she didn't expect... but it was true.
"Ying'er, how long are you going to be angry with me? I have accepted my fate and accepted the fact that Xu'er will not come back again. You are not Xu'er. There is no way you can live in his place, right?" She only hopes that the only remaining daughter can return to normal and stop being neither a boy nor a girl.
She had long regretted the incident three years ago when she got mad and pushed her daughter down in front of her son's mourning hall. But the rift had already arisen and she couldn't bear to apologize. The relationship between mother and daughter was getting worse and worse.
"Why not?" After so many years, she still couldn't get her mother's approval, which made her very unfair and angry. "I've done everything I can do, right?"
She is no longer a weak girl who knows nothing. She can manage the grain store by herself, deal with and do business with a group of men. There is nothing that she can't do except doingBack to the original Liang Zhaoying.
"But you are still a woman after all, not a man. If Xu'er was still here, maybe he would have married and had children and carried on the Liang family's lineage, but can you?" She wanted to talk to her daughter nicely, but she was provoked by her daughter, and her words couldn't help but become harsh.
Liang Zhaoying's expression suddenly froze, and she couldn't find the words to retaliate for a moment, but after a while, she turned to laugh out loud, as if she had heard something very ridiculous.
